subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `PluginHookAgentContext.api.resetSession(reason?)` become a supported after-compaction-only plugin contract across successful embedded and native compaction paths?
rationale: This is a new public plugin capability with deferred completion semantics and session-state effects; code correctness alone cannot decide whether OpenClaw wants to support that contract long-term.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Adopt the current-session-only, successful-after-compaction, lifecycle-deferred API after fixing successor-session guarding and adding real behavior proof.

options.title: Keep reset ownership internal
options.body: Remove the public hook API and expose any required recovery behavior through an owner-specific internal plugin or context-engine contract instead.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the current-session-only, successful-after-compaction, lifecycle-deferred API after fixing successor-session guarding and adding real behavior proof.
